slides.title: 5 rug brands on every yard
slides.sub: In no particular order. How many are in your tack room?

slides.title: Horseware Ireland
slides.body: The Irish brand behind the Rambo range. You'll spot one on most yards in about five seconds.

slides.title: WeatherBeeta
slides.body: Home of the ComFiTec range, and probably a few in your tack room right now.

slides.title: Shires
slides.body: The Tempest Original range is the one plenty of us started out with.

slides.title: Bucas
slides.body: Another Irish rug maker, with owners who swear by theirs.

slides.title: Premier Equine
slides.body: The Buster range runs from a 40g lightweight right up to a 400g heavyweight.

slides.title: Not sponsored. Just rug obsessed.
slides.question: Which brand is your horse wearing?
